# RoomXDynamics

> RoomXDynamics is a qualitative simulation of room air and walls for iPhone, in development and not yet available in the App Store. It shows a slice through a room with an outside wall and a window: how warm and cool air move in the model and how cool the wall surface gets. The results are trends in the model, not values for a real room. It is not a measurement and not an expert report.

Key facts:

- Platform: iPhone (iOS). Status: in development, no release date, price not set.
- Audience: people who furnish, renovate or design their home.
- Air in the room: a simplified two-dimensional picture, qualitative only.
- Wall surface: steady-state heat conduction with common design values, not checked against standard texts; a qualitative risk estimate in three levels, with a range. It does not say whether mould will grow on a real wall, or why.
- The results have not been checked against real rooms.
- The website has no cookies, no analytics and no tracking.
- From the makers of [FlatSixDynamics](https://flatsixdynamics.com/) and MachXDynamics.
